newsitem.title: USA: Congo seeks 13,300 T PL-480 long grain rice - agent.
newsitem.headline: Congo seeks 13,300 T PL-480 long grain rice - agent.

text.p: The Republic of the Congo seeks to buy about 13,300 tonnes of U.S. long grain milled rice under the PL-480 Title I export program, said Amex International Inc, the Congo's buying agent.
Offers are due at the agent's Washington D.C., office by 1400 EDT/1800 GMT Wednesday.
Shipment is for November 5-20 and offers are to be quoted U.S. dollars free-alongside ship. (FAS).
The rice is grade U.S. No.5 or better, containing not more than 20 percent broken kernels.
